a few minutes: until `ready` is true, it can't take candidates; the `interview.ready` web

post.description:
Invites the candidate to the interview on behalf of the key's creator and reserves credits
for them, with their name if given. By default prepza emails the invitation and the
candidate signs in with that email; with `sign_in` false, your platform sends them to the
response's `invite_url`, which opens the interview without signing in. With a `return_url`,
the finished page takes the candidate back to your platform. Inviting an address that was
already invited sends the invitation again, if emails are on; one who already finished is
returned as they are, without an email.

Needs the `candidates:invite` permission.

Withdraws an invite the candidate hasn't used yet: its link stops working and its credits
come back. A candidate who started is erased for good, with their answers and results, for
example when they ask to have their data deleted; one who answered at least one question is
charged. Your web hooks get `candidate.removed`.

Needs the `candidates:delete` permission.

get.description: A web hook's latest sends and how they went, newest first; every member sees them.

schema.title: Response Webhook Log Manage Webhooks  Webhook Id  Log Get

name.title: Name
name.description: The candidate's name: as given when they were invited, edited by an owner or admin, or else from their sign-in when they start; null while unknown

status.title: Status
status.description: One of invited, undelivered, in_process, finished, expired or deleted

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: Final grade in percent; null until the candidate finishes

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: Whether the grade reached the pass mark; null until the candidate finishes. It supports a person's decision: don't reject a candidate automatically on it

flagged.title: Flagged
flagged.description: Whether the integrity signals are too many to trust the result as it is: worth a person's look at the full results, not a reason to reject

extra_time.title: Extra Time
extra_time.description: Extra time per question the company gave the candidate, in percent

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Each section's grade, in order; only when one candidate is read, and in web hook events (null in lists)

results_url.title: Results Url
results_url.description: Link to the candidate's full results and report in prepza

invite_url.title: Invite Url
invite_url.description: The candidate's invite link, to send them yourself if the invite email didn't arrive; null once they've finished or the invite has expired

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: When the invitation was first sent

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the candidate last changed (status, name, extra time or result; not the progress while they answer); to sync, pass the last one you got as `updated_since`, with its `id` as `after`

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: When the candidate started; null before

finished_at.title: Finished At
finished_at.description: When the candidate finished; null before

CandidateEvent.title: CandidateEvent
CandidateEvent.description:
The `data` object of a candidate's event (`candidate.finished`, `candidate.started`,
`candidate.undelivered`, `candidate.expired`): the interview and the candidate as they are
when it's sent.

name.title: Name
name.description: The candidate's name, optional (at most 200 characters). It fills a name not known yet; inviting the same address again doesn't change a known one

return_url.title: Return Url
return_url.description: Where to take the candidate once they've finished, optional: an https address on the company's verified website domain (or a subdomain of it); see Verified companies. The finished page shows a button to it, with `prepza_invite=<candidate id>` added to its query

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The theme the candidate's pages show, in your company's colors for it: `light` or `dark` always shows that theme, `default` the candidate's own. A `theme` added to the `invite_url` (`?theme=dark`) or given to the SDK wins over it

sign_in.title: Sign In
sign_in.description: Whether the candidate signs in to prepza with this email, which prepza sends the invitation and its reminder to. Set it to false when your platform already knows who the candidate is and sends them to the response's `invite_url` itself: the link then opens the interview without signing in, and prepza sends no emails. Anyone with that link can take the interview, so give it only to the candidate

name.title: Name
name.description: The candidate's name; an empty string makes it unknown

extra_time.title: Extra Time
extra_time.description: Extra time on each question, in percent, for a candidate who needs it; only before they start (409 after)

id.title: Id
id.description: The event's id: the same when it's sent again

type.title: Type
type.description: The event's type, such as candidate.finished

occurred_at.title: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: When the change happened, to put events in order: a retried one can arrive after a later one

available.title: Available
available.description: Credits your company can spend now

reserved.title: Reserved
reserved.description: Credits set aside for candidates who haven't finished

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: How many more candidates the available credits pay for

low.title: Low
low.description: Whether the credits are running low

title.title: Title
title.description: Null while the interview's questions are being generated

status.title: Status
status.description: One of new, in_process or hired

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Whether the questions are ready and candidates can be invited

pass_mark.title: Pass Mark
pass_mark.description: The minimum grade, in percent, a candidate needs to pass

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When it last changed; to sync, pass the last one you got as `updated_since`, with its `id` as `after`

job_description.title: Job Description
job_description.description: The job description to make the interview from, at most 10000 characters

language.title: Language
language.description: The language to write the interview in, as a code such as `en` or `de`; by default the job description's own

id.title: Id
id.description: The event's id: the same when it's sent again

type.title: Type
type.description: The event's type, such as candidate.finished

occurred_at.title: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: When the change happened, to put events in order: a retried one can arrive after a later one

Section.title: Section
